FN-5V8LQ33-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 138
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Representative Kenneth Paschal
Analyst: Michael Russo Date: 02/12/2026
House Bill 138 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education would allow
certain retirees of the Employees' Retirement System (ERS) and the Teachers' Retirement
System (TRS) to return to work without suspension of retirement pay and benefits as sheriff's
deputies, municipal police officers, school bus drivers, and assistant district attorneys, provided
the retiree's annual compensation does not exceed the amounts authorized pursuant to the
provisions of this bill.
This bill could increase the obligations of state or local agencies, that employ these individuals
by an undetermined amount dependent upon any additional compensation paid to previously
retired employees under the provisions of this bill. The provisions of this bill would end
December 31, 2032.
